scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is for the specific difference-plus-mean generator under doubly transitive permutation actions. It proves uniqueness up to unimodular phase and coordinatewise conjugation, not stability, ordinary phase retrieval, or a classification of all generators. The finite verifier is only a consistency test; the all-dimension claim is supported by the analytic proof.
title: Full-space conjugate phase retrieval from difference-plus-mean permutation orbits
